primary.title: Max Healthcare, Fortis, Apollo, Aster: Hospital stocks steal show on D-Street with up to 14% rally - Buy now or wait?
primary.summary: Hospital stocks rallied up to 14% over five trading sessions amid optimism about corporate earnings and growth prospects. Apollo Hospitals, Fortis, Max Healthcare and Aster DM Quality Care all advanced on Friday, with brokerages maintaining Buy ratings on Apollo, Fortis and Max.
